title: ACAP command payload (server → adapter)
description: The `data` of a type:cmd envelope. The Commander MUST only send an intent the adapter declared in accepted.capabilities.

cmdId.description: Unique command id; the unit of idempotency and ack correlation.

source.description: Human-readable provenance for audit/logs. MUST NOT drive authz (already authorized by the Commander).

answer.description: Required when intent == answer. Matches a waiting.options value, or free text for waiting.kind == input.
